metadata.question: Does surface temperature decrease in non-water areas with higher vegetation density in New York City on August 14, 2002?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need surface temperature data: Landsat 7 ETM+ (has thermal band and good for 2002) - Need vegetation data: NDVI from same Landsat image - Date: August 14, 2002 - Location: New York City boundaries 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask water bodies (question asks about "non-water areas") - Need to mask clouds - Use NDVI to identify vegetated vs non-vegetated areas 3. Logic: - Calculate correlation between NDVI and surface temperature - If correlation is negative and significant, answer is A (Yes) - If correlation is positive or near zero, answer is B (No) - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid calculations) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // Define NYC geometry const nyc = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-74.3, 40.5, -73.7, 40.9]); // Get Landsat 7 data for August 14, 2002 const collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(nyc) .filterDate('2002-08-14', '2002-08-15') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { // Try wider date range const collection2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(nyc) .filterDate('2002-08-10', '2002-08-20') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size2 = await collection2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images with wider range: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } } const image = collection.mean(); // Calculate NDVI const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI'); // Calculate surface temperature (Landsat 7 band 6) const thermal = image.select('ST_B6').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0).subtract(273.15).rename('temp'); // Mask water using NDVI (water typically has NDVI < 0) const landMask = ndvi.gt(0); // Mask clouds using QA band const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); // Apply masks const maskedNDVI = ndvi.updateMask(landMask).updateMask(cloudMask); const maskedTemp = thermal.updateMask(landMask).updateMask(cloudMask); // Check pixel counts const stats = await maskedNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: nyc, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = stats.NDVI || 0; console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Sample points and calculate correlation const combined = maskedNDVI.addBands(maskedTemp); const sample = combined.sample({ region: nyc, scale: 3000, numPixels: 500, geometries: false }); const sampleSize = await sample.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sample points: ${sampleSize}`); if (sampleSize === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate correlation const correlation = await sample.reduceColumns({ reducer: ee.Reducer.pearsonsCorrelation(), selectors: ['NDVI', 'temp'] }).getInfo(); const corr = correlation.correlation; const pValue = correlation['p-value']; console.log(`Correlation: ${corr}`); console.log(`P-value: ${pValue}`); // Get mean values for context const meanStats = await combined.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nyc, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); console.log(`Mean NDVI: ${meanStats.NDVI ? meanStats.NDVI.toFixed(3) : 'N/A'}`); console.log(`Mean Temp: ${meanStats.temp ? meanStats.temp.toFixed(2) : 'N/A'}°C`); if (corr === null || isNaN(corr) || meanStats.NDVI === null || meanStats.temp === null) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Negative correlation means temperature decreases with higher vegetation if (corr < -0.1 && pValue < 0.1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } catch (error) { console.log(`Error: ${error.message}`); console.log("D"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
